result.topic_en: Calculations on linear transformations of coordinates for an ellipsoid (direction cosines, principal axes, eigenvalue equations) and time derivatives of quantities for the rotating fluid ellipsoid, plus a stray note on a limit involving sums of logarithms.

methods.what: Limit defining a function chi(s) via sums of logarithmic differences
Linear transformation of ellipsoid coordinates and invariance of quadratic form
Principal axes via Lagrange multiplier / eigenvalue equations for quadratic form
Linear eigenvector system for principal axes
Successive time derivatives of P = l^2 (Leibniz rule)
